sourceNotes.coin: Owner-provided 1254x1254 transparent gold coin reference: raised five-point star, inset face and stacked bright rim. Model uses geometry and PBR only; no exact raster parity claimed.
sourceNotes.crown: Owner-provided 1254x1254 transparent purple crown reference: center and side tines, segmented base and bright tip gems. Model uses geometry and PBR only; no exact raster parity claimed.
sourceNotes.neonGlyphs: Reconstructed as solid 3D counterparts of the existing browser SVG strokes; colors copied from current Mega XOXO Neon CSS. Glow is restrained emissive material, not a baked effect.
sourceNotes.rankFamily: Eleven canonical raster rank designs were inventoried before modeling. SourcePNG prompts and material palettes are recorded in assets/p21/art/ranks/PROMPTS.json; Diamond uses the existing crystal-source.png and diamond.webp. Geometry shares the angular shield/segmented-wing silhouette while tier materials and finials stay distinct. It is not a pixel-exact raster trace.
sourceNotes.trophy: Owner-provided transparent trophy source inspected: wide gold handled bowl, raised five-point star, laurel-like side ornaments, narrow neck and black/gold stepped pedestal. Model reconstructs the visible forms as genuine geometry; no exact raster parity claimed.
sourceNotes.rewardChest: No owner-supplied reward-chest source image exists in the available asset registry; this is an explicitly provisional closed black-and-gold decorative chest geometry, with no visible contents or claimed economy meaning.
sourceNotes.boardPlates: The approved home capture and current siteMiniTheme/CSS were inspected. Two independent vertical boards reproduce the three diagonal X or O mark positions and current Neon edge/grid palette as 3D mesh plates. They are decorative standalone studies, not replacements for the approved card render.
sourceNotes.materialLimits: Materials use procedural MeshStandardMaterial PBR values only. There are no image textures, normal maps, roughness maps or metalness maps; wood grain, stone microtexture and iridescent fine detail remain open.
